title: ossready project config
description: Project-level config for ossready doctor filters (.ossreadyrc, .ossreadyrc.json, .ossready.json, or the "ossready" key in package.json). Put persistent --check / --skip / --strict here so local runs and CI stay in sync. See docs/configuration.md.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema URL for editor validation (for example the schema shipped in this package).

check.description: Only run these doctor check ids (same meaning as `ossready doctor --check`).

skip.description: Skip these doctor check ids (same meaning as `ossready doctor --skip`).

strict.description: Also fail (exit 1) when recommended doctor checks are missing (same meaning as `ossready doctor --strict`). `--ignore-config` drops it for one run.

doctor.description: Optional nested form; doctor.check / doctor.skip / doctor.strict win over top-level twins when both are present.

idList.description: One or more doctor check ids from `ossready doctor --list` / docs/checks.md. Accepts a string, a comma-separated string, or an array of strings.
